import zipfile, json, pathlib, re
z=zipfile.ZipFile('fuzzing/corpora/dynsec_config_seed_corpus.zip')
text=z.read('14-dynsec-client.conf.json').decode()
# create a variant with many clients and groups to stress cleanup
obj=json.loads(text)
obj['clients']=[{'username':f'u{i}','roles':[]} for i in range(2000)]
obj['groups']=[{'groupname':f'g{i}','clients':[{'username':f'u{i}'}]} for i in range(2000)]
out='/tmp/poc_big.json'
open(out,'w').write(json.dumps(obj))
print(out, len(open(out).read()))
PY
